T1158.long: To prevent normal users from accidentally changing special files on a system, most operating systems have the concept of a ‘hidden’ file. These files don’t show up when a user browses the file system with a GUI or when using normal commands on the command line. Users must explicitly ask to show the hidden files either via a series of Graphical User Interface (GUI) prompts or with command line switches (dir /a for Windows and ls –a for Linux and macOS).

strings: A direct or indirect connection or relationship between any director, employee, partner, sub-contractor or other person associated with a company wishing to participate in a DH tender process ( the
),and a civil servant, external consultant, subject matter expert or other person, engaged by DH in any stage of a DH Tender process (the
any financial, political, personal or other interest of an Officer

where that connection, relationship or interest prevents, has the potential to prevent or may be perceived to prevent, the Officer or Employee from carrying out any activities connected with the Tender in a fair, impartial and objective manner;

A conflict of interest may not in itself bar a tenderer from participation in a DH tender; however, suitable checks and safeguards must be put in place, verified independently and recorded, to ensure that the affected parties take no part, directly or otherwise, in the tender and award process.
Every participant in a DH tender; including DH employees and the authorised

representatives of the tendering company, must sign a declaration confirming that no conflict of interest exists and that in the event of a conflict arising during the tender process, that fact will immediately be communicated to the SRO or Tender Manager.
Tenderers and Evaluation panel members are strongly advised, if they have any doubts as to what may or may not be a conflict of interest, to discuss the circumstances with DH PCoE.
A failure to declare a potential conflict of interest may invalidate the tender process and any subsequent contract award.
